title: Iceberg Schema for Parquet to DSS conversion
description: Schema for converting parquet files to HEC-DSS format using field mapping

timestamp.description: Timestamp field - maps to datetime column

provider.description: Provider - maps to DSS path part A

site_id.description: Site ID - maps to DSS path part B

variable.description: Variable - maps to DSS path part C

increment.description: Increment - maps to DSS path part E

qualifier.description: Qualifier - maps to DSS path part F
